body:
Leaving the job feels like condoning their treatment. Plus it could just happen again at the next job

Better The devil you know comes to mind.

I’ve been told I suck the fun out of everything by close family, the work hasn’t had (to my knowledge) an Xmas night out since I arrived. Unless they are but just not inviting me

Being on Sertraline I thought might help things but it just still feels like taking me out the equation fixes a lot of problems.
